name: Desperate Volley
body:
School enchantment Level antipaladin 4, cleric/oracle 6, lathspell 4, paladin 4, ranger 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 feet + 5 feet/2 levels)
Target 1 enemy plus 1 per caster level (see text)
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You can stoke the fury of your allies and concentrate their efforts on a single foe.

When you cast this spell you must choose targets from among creatures with ranged weapons in hand. Each targeted creature may make a ranged attack against a single enemy you designate within the first two range increments of their weapon. The attacks granted by this spell are treated as attacks of opportunity and count against each targeted creatures’ number of available attacks of opportunity for the round.
